items.name: LVM snapshots
items.explanation: LVM is the Linux logical volume manager. A snapshot is a new logical volume that shows the contents of another volume as they were at the moment it was made, which makes it a quick way to freeze a disk for copying.

items.name: DMARC
items.explanation: A mail standard that lets a domain owner publish a policy for how receiving servers should treat messages that claim to come from the domain but fail authentication. A receiver may reject such mail.
